)

0x0e

Synchronous

Non Reentrant

None

None

None
Return value

This function resets the Inhibited COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION request Counter.
Available via
ComM.h

tionEnabled (see [ECUC_ComM_00560]). Function will only be available if ComM-
ModeLimitationEnabled (see [ECUC_ComM_00560]) is enabled and ComMGlob-
alNvMBlockDescriptor is configured.⌋
